sections.h2: Distilleries offered 1,776 crore litres of ethanol against a need of about 1,050

chart.title: Roughly 726 crore litres of distillery capacity had no buyer in 2025-26
chart.source: Distillery offers and requirement, as reported in the post.

sections.means: The spare asset in the maize chain is fermenter volume and starch-to-glucose plant, not the grain itself.
sections.todo: Read the surplus as spare fermenter and distillery capacity, not spare grain, before planning around it.

sections.h2: Hyaluronic acid earns most per tonne of maize, but takes almost none of it

chart.title: Per tonne of maize, hyaluronic acid is worth about 28 times ethanol
chart.sub: Rupees of product per tonne of maize, at 0.65 t glucose per tonne.
chart.source: India import or export unit values, 2024-26; this blog's assumptions.

sections.means: Cosmetic ingredients are worth a great deal per tonne and consume almost no grain, so they are not a maize outlet.
sections.todo: Treat cosmetic ingredients as import-substitution targets, and fund purification and fermentation plants rather than grain supply.

sections.h2: Citric acid, not hyaluronic acid, is the volume that maize could feed

chart.title: Replacing India's citric acid imports would take 290,763 tonnes of maize
chart.sub: Tonnes of maize needed per year.
chart.source: This piece's calculations from the post's yields and import figures.

sections.means: Citric acid is the volume story, still under half a per cent of the crop.
sections.todo: Judge any maize-based plant by its tonnage and its competitor's capacity, not by the value of its product.
